evals.prompt:
Author a reusable multi-module Titan library packaged as a LuaRocks format `3.0` rock named `titan-metric` (`0.1.0-1`) that bundles a canonical folder module and a sibling submodule into a single common-prefix provider.

Create these files:
1. Canonical folder module `metric.core` under `src/metric/core/`:
   - `src/metric/core/core.titan` (main file): exports `record Sample` with `const label: string` and `const value: integer`, `function make_sample(label: string, value: integer): Sample`, and `function scale(s: Sample, factor: integer): integer` (delegating to the folder-local helper `scaled_value` defined in `math_contrib.titan`).
   - `src/metric/core/math_contrib.titan` (contributor file — no `do ... end` initializer): defines `local function scaled_value(v: integer, factor: integer): integer` returning `v * factor`.
2. Sibling module `src/metric/format.titan` (logical module `metric.format`):
   - Imports `metric.core` and exports `function render(s: core.Sample, factor: integer): string` returning `s.label .. "=" .. core.scale(s, factor)`.
3. Native tests in `tests/metric_test.titan`:
   - Public `test_*(context: test.Context)` verifying `metric.core` and `metric.format` (`render(make_sample("cpu", 7), 3) == "cpu=21"`), runnable via `titanc --incremental --test --tree "src;tests" --test-dir tests`.
4. Format `3.0` rockspec `titan-metric-0.1.0-1.rockspec`:
   - Must execute cleanly in LuaRocks' empty `_ENV` (no globals such as `table`).
   - Declare `package = "titan-metric"`, `version = "0.1.0-1"`, and `dependencies = { "lua ~> 5.5", "titan ~> 0.6" }`.
   - `build` (`type = "command"`): compile both roots together (`"$(SCRIPTS_DIR)/titanc" --incremental --tree src --output build metric.core metric.format` — NEVER pass `--static` on a library!) to emit the common-prefix provider `build/metric.so` and `build/metric.a`; stage ONLY those two final files into `"$(PREFIX)/dist/modules/"` (never copy `build/` wholesale, intermediates, `dist/bin/`, or symlinks). Include `platforms.windows` `cmd.exe` overrides compiling with `titanc.exe` and staging `build\metric.dll` into `$(PREFIX)\dist\modules\metric.dll`.
   - `hooks`: set `post_install = '"$(SCRIPTS_DIR)/titan-install" --path "$(PREFIX)"'` with `platforms.windows.post_install = '"$(SCRIPTS_DIR)\titan-install.bat" --path "$(PREFIX)"'`.

assertions.check: Implements canonical folder module `src/metric/core/{core,math_contrib}.titan` (shared `local` scope, private non-importable contributor) plus `src/metric/format.titan`, and compiles both roots without `--static` into a single common-prefix provider pair `metric.so` + `metric.a`.

Format `3.0` empty-`_ENV`-safe rockspec declares `lua ~> 5.5` and `titan ~> 0.6`, includes Windows `cmd.exe` overrides, stages ONLY `modules/metric.so` and `modules/metric.a` under `$(PREFIX)/dist/`, publishes via `titan-install --path "$(PREFIX)"`, passes native tests, and serves an outside consumer across dynamic, `--static`, and bare-Lua `require "titan"` modes.

evals.judge_rubric: Score `idiom_score = 3` only if `oracle_pkg01.py` exits `0` (empty-`_ENV` rockspec audit, native tests, `luarocks --tree /verify/rock-tree make`, clean `dist/` audit, outside dynamic/`--static`/Lua consumer checks, and private-contributor check all pass) and both assertions hold. Cap at `<= 1` if `--static` is passed to library `titanc`, extra build intermediates leak into `$(PREFIX)/dist/`, `post_install` omits `titan-install --path "$(PREFIX)"`, Windows overrides are missing, or rockspec fails in empty `_ENV`.

evals.prompt:
Using the provided C helper files `helper.h` and `helper.c` (located at the workspace root — treat both as read-only), author a source-only Titan dependency rock and a two-version compiled multi-module provider rock that links the private C object via `-X`, depends on the installed source-only rock without embedding it, ships a public header under `dist/include/bundle/`, and upgrades cleanly from `v1` to `v2` without breaking already-compiled dynamic consumers.

Create these three rock directories:
1. `base-rock/` — source-only rock `titan-tagfmt` (`0.1.0-1`):
   - `base-rock/titan-tagfmt-0.1.0-1.rockspec`: format `3.0` empty-`_ENV`-safe rockspec (`package = "titan-tagfmt"`, `version = "0.1.0-1"`, `dependencies = { "lua ~> 5.5", "titan ~> 0.6" }`) staging `tagfmt.titan` into `$(PREFIX)/dist/modules/tagfmt.titan` and invoking `"$(SCRIPTS_DIR)/titan-install" --path "$(PREFIX)"` in `hooks.post_install` (with `platforms.windows` overrides).
   - `tagfmt` module (`base-rock/src/tagfmt.titan` or `base-rock/dist/modules/tagfmt.titan`): exports `function bracket(tag: string, body: string): string` returning `"[" .. tag .. "]" .. body`.
2. `v1/` — compiled multi-module provider rock `titan-bundle` (`1.0.0-1`):
   - `v1/src/bundle/hash.titan` (`bundle.hash`): imports `helper.h`, exports `record Digest` with ordered public fields `const tag: string` and `const score: integer`, and `function compute(a: integer, b: integer): Digest` returning `Digest("h1", bundle_mix_hash(a, b))`.
   - `v1/src/bundle/report.titan` (`bundle.report`): imports `bundle.hash` and installed source module `tagfmt` via ordinary `import "tagfmt"` (NEVER explicit `.titan` import across the installed source boundary!), exports `function describe(d: hash.Digest): string` returning `tagfmt.bracket(d.tag, ":" .. d.score)`.
   - `v1/titan-bundle-1.0.0-1.rockspec`: format `3.0` empty-`_ENV`-safe rockspec declaring `dependencies = { "lua ~> 5.5", "titan ~> 0.6", "titan-tagfmt ~> 0.1" }`, compiling `../helper.c` with `-fPIC -c -I .. -o build/helper.o` and linking `bundle.hash bundle.report -X build/helper.o` via `"$(SCRIPTS_DIR)/titanc"` (with `--tree src -I .. --output build`, NO `--static`!), staging ONLY `build/bundle.so` + `build/bundle.a` into `$(PREFIX)/dist/modules/` and `../helper.h` into `$(PREFIX)/dist/include/bundle/helper.h` (NEVER `dist/include/titan/`), and running `titan-install --path "$(PREFIX)"` in `hooks.post_install`.
3. `v2/` — DSO binary-compatible upgrade `titan-bundle` (`2.0.0-1`):
   - `v2/src/bundle/hash.titan` (`bundle.hash`): MUST preserve full DSO binary compatibility for an already-compiled v1 consumer (keep `Digest` public field names/types/order and `compute(a: integer, b: integer): Digest` signature including parameter names unchanged!), while exercising safe DSO-compatible changes: update `compute` to return `Digest("h2", bundle_mix_hash(a, b) + 1000)` and add a new unused public export `function release_tag(): string` returning `"v2"`.
   - `v2/src/bundle/report.titan` (`bundle.report`): same public contract as `v1`.
   - `v2/titan-bundle-2.0.0-1.rockspec`: same packaging structure as `v1` with `version = "2.0.0-1"`.

assertions.check: Publishes source-only `titan-tagfmt` (`tagfmt.titan`) and compiled `titan-bundle` depending on `tagfmt` via ordinary `import "tagfmt"` (leaving `tagfmt` external for consumer single-owner compilation under `-o`), carries `-X build/helper.o` into both `bundle.so` and `bundle.a` (serving both dynamic and `--static` consumers), and stages `helper.h` under `dist/include/bundle/` (never `dist/include/titan/`).

Upgrading `titan-bundle` from `1.0.0-1` to `2.0.0-1` preserves used signatures/parameter names/public `Digest` layout while adding unused `release_tag()` so an unrebuilt v1 dynamic consumer seamlessly prints `[h2]:1033` (while already-linked `--static` consumer stays `[h1]:33`); `titan-uninstall` respects LuaRocks dependency checks, preserves active `2.0.0-1` when removing inactive `1.0.0-1`, removes all published `bundle.*` and `include/bundle/helper.h` on active uninstall, removes `tagfmt.titan` cleanly, and treats absent-rock removal as a no-op.

evals.judge_rubric: Score `idiom_score = 3` only if `oracle_pkg02.py` exits `0` (source-only install, v1 install + outside dynamic/`--static` builds, v2 unrebuilt dynamic hot-swap to `[h2]:1033`, Lua `release_tag() == "v2"`, and full `titan-uninstall` lifecycle all pass) and both assertions hold. Cap at `<= 1` if `bundle.report` uses explicit `tagfmt.titan` import, `-X` fails to embed `helper.o` in `bundle.a`, `helper.h` is staged into `include/titan/`, v2 breaks DSO binary compatibility (changing param names or `Digest` fields), or `titan-bundle` omits `titan-tagfmt` from `dependencies`.
